note: Question catalog for LLM decisions (process Q). Callers use ids only. Changing any text of a question requires bumping its version, because a rewritten question is a different question and its calibration no longer applies; python/tests/test_futures_llm_decisions.py pins a hash per id@version. Each question declares the STATE fields it needs (names from the registry STATE_FIELDS in futures_llm_decisions.py); adding a question, any number of options or any of the three types (choice, bool, score) needs no code change.

questions.instruction: Using only the normalized market state above, where is the price most likely to be one hour from now compared with the last close?

options.description: higher by more than 15 basis points
lower by more than 15 basis points
within 15 basis points of the last close in either direction
